label: Empirical Examples
description: Real species and study cases mapped to the concept they illustrate.

cards.definition: Demonstrates measurable evolution by natural selection in real time. Pre-drought beak depth ~9.31 mm; survivors ~9.84 mm; S=0.53; h²≈0.78; predicted R≈0.41 mm matched observed next-generation shift. Validates breeder's equation.

Demonstrates differential bird predation by background-matching. Pollution killed lichen → trunks blackened → melanic morph rose to >95%. Clean-air laws reversed the shift. Genetic basis: cortex-gene transposon insertion.

Demonstrate artificial selection (domestication). Greyhounds: ~20% faster than ancestral dogs over centuries. Belyaev's foxes: visible behavioral and morphological tameness in 10 generations. Same R=h²·S; bigger S than nature.

Demonstrate antagonistic coevolution arms race. Newts evolve TTX; sympatric snakes evolve resistant Na channels; trait values match across the range (Geographic Mosaic). Snake resistance trade-off with locomotion caps escalation.

Demonstrates mutualistic coevolution by reciprocal selection. 25-cm spur predicted a long-tongued moth pollinator; Xanthopan morganii praedicta found decades later with matching tongue. Tight match is a coevolutionary equilibrium.

Demonstrate Geographic Mosaic Theory. Beaks and cone morphology match locally in some valleys (hotspots), mismatch in others (coldspots). Mismatch is positive evidence of dynamic coevolution, not refutation.

Demonstrates cis-regulatory evolution. Repeated independent loss of pelvic spines via enhancer deletion at Pitx1 in freshwater populations. Coding region intact (still works in teeth) — pleiotropic cost avoided by tissue-specific cis change.
Demonstrates that proteome complexity can vastly exceed gene count. One gene → >38,000 mRNA isoforms via alternative splicing. Refutes naive 'gene number = complexity' assumption.
Demonstrates common descent. ~95% identical human-rhesus, ~90% human-dog, ~75% human-fly. Graded similarity tracks divergence time; supports universal common ancestor.

Demonstrates that bipedalism preceded big brains in hominin evolution. ~3.2 Mya, brain ~400 cc (chimp-sized), but pelvis + valgus knee + foot arch confirm bipedality. Mosaic with retained arboreal traits.

Demonstrates inbreeding depression and rescue. Severely inbred ~30 individuals showed heart defects + sperm abnormalities; 8 Texas pumas introduced; F1 hybrid descendants showed restored fitness; population grew to ~200.

Demonstrates captive-breeding rescue + ongoing risk. By 1987 only 27 birds left; pedigree-managed breeding rebuilt population to ~500. Lead poisoning from carcasses still kills wild birds — root cause unsolved.

Demonstrates anthropogenic directional selection. Size-limit fishing removed large/late-maturing individuals; mean size at maturity declined within ~10–20 generations. Selective harvest can reverse natural selection direction.

cards.term: Bighorn sheep horn shrinkage (Ram Mountain, Alberta)
cards.definition: Demonstrates trophy-hunting-induced evolution. Mean horn size declined ~25% over 30 yr; h² of horn size ~0.7. Hunters preferentially killed largest-horned rams → heritable shift toward smaller.
Demonstrates adaptive introgression. Tibetan high-altitude EPAS1 haplotype matches Denisovan genome; frequency ~87% in Tibetans (far above neighbors); strong recent positive selection signal.

Demonstrates heterozygote advantage / balancing selection. HbS persists at ~5–15% in malaria-endemic regions despite homozygote lethality; Heterozygotes are malaria-resistant; absent where malaria absent.

Demonstrates long-term balancing selection. Some MHC alleles persist tens of millions of years; humans and chimps share alleles. Driven by heterozygote advantage + negative frequency-dependent selection from coevolving pathogens.
Demonstrates peripatric speciation. ~1,000 endemic species from one founder ~25 MYA; phylogeny nested by island age; each new island colonized by founders from older neighbor.
Demonstrates rapid speciation under ecological opportunity + key innovation. Hundreds of species in <1 MYR in young Rift lakes; pharyngeal-jaw novelty + rapid niche specialization.

Demonstrates sympatric host-race speciation in progress. Host shift from hawthorn to apple within ~150 yr created assortative mating + diverging selection; populations show genetic differentiation despite no geographic barrier.
Demonstrates reinforcement of prezygotic isolation. Greater song divergence in zones of overlap than in pure-population zones; selection against unfit hybrids strengthens prezygotic barrier.
Demonstrates rock-paper-scissors negative frequency-dependent selection. Three male morphs (orange/blue/yellow) cycle in frequency every ~5–6 yr; no single ESS — stable cycles instead.

Demonstrates kin selection + ecological constraint. Daughters on high-quality territories stay to help raise siblings (r=0.5); on low-quality, they disperse. Hamilton's rule + saturated good territories.
Demonstrates a sharp biogeographic boundary maintained by deep-water trenches. Asian fauna west; Australasian fauna east; <30 km separation but never connected during glacial low-stands.

cards.term: Glossopteris (Permian seed fern) on Gondwanan continents
cards.definition: Demonstrates continental drift (vicariance). Same fossil seed plant on S.America, Africa, India, Australia, Antarctica; seeds couldn't disperse across modern oceans → required connected landmasses.
Demonstrates ongoing pathogen evolution under host immunity. ~0.5% sequence change per yr on surface antigens; escapes prior antibody recognition; requires annual vaccine update.
Demonstrates direct reciprocity. Bats regurgitate blood meals to non-relatives that fed them previously; documented record-keeping over months. Tit-for-tat in repeated encounters.
Demonstrates antagonistic sexual conflict. Males pierce female abdomen to inseminate; females evolve thickened spermalege organs → arms race within species; rapid genitalic divergence.
Demonstrates allopatric speciation by geographic barrier. Squirrel populations on opposite rims diverged in isolation; now distinct subspecies/species with different morphology.

Demonstrates protein cooption. Antifreeze evolved from a digestive enzyme that had weak ice-binding side activity; selection refined the side activity into a primary function. Novelty from existing toolkit.
Demonstrates slow life history under low extrinsic mortality. ~100 yr lifespan, delayed maturity, low reproduction; vulnerable to introduced predators (rats, dogs).

Demonstrate two stable life-history strategies given different mortality regimes. Salmon: high return-mortality → big-bang reproduction once. Albatross: low adult mortality → slow steady reproduction across decades.
Demonstrates climate-driven mismatch. Photoperiod-cued migration unchanged; caterpillar prey peak weeks earlier each year due to warming; chicks fledged with poor provisioning; population decline.

Demonstrates transitional fossil + crown vs stem distinction. Mosaic of feathers + bird wings + dinosaur teeth/tail. Stem-group bird; not in modern crown. Documents incremental assembly of bird body plan.
